text:
jacob_cust: Hey, our analytics dashboard is showing zero model buckets when both Region=ap-southeast-1 and ModelVersion=2.1 are selected on our org's shared view. Ticket #45289. Any quick checks? 

emily_support: thanks for filing, jacob. can you share the exact console URL and a screenshot? also which org and dashboard id?

jacob_cust: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acme/dashboards/789/screenshots -> screenshot attached to ticket (looks like empty chart + "no data for selection"). org=acme, dashboard=789. Works if i uncheck region or version individually.

taylor_frontend: pinging the dashboard team — does this sound like the multi-select normalization bug we saw last month? :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: deploy status: frontend/topbar v1.12 -> success :white_check_mark:

raj_backend: could be query rewrite? when both filters present we generate WHERE region IN (...) AND model_version = '2.1' — maybe model aliases mapping returns empty set for that region. asking for logs.

mira_qa: repro steps from my side:
1) open shared dashboard as user @viewer
2) select Region: ap-southeast-1 + ModelVersion: 2.1
3) time range last 24h
result: chart shows "No data" but raw events in logs include entries for model 2.1 in ap-southeast-1

emily_support: that mismatch is critical. jacob — can you paste a small example request payload from the console (network inspector)?

jacob_cust: here's the network payload snippet:
```
{ "filters": { "region": ["ap-southeast-1"], "model_version": ["2.1"] }, "shared_view": true }
```

taylor_frontend: frontend sends shorthand keys, backend normalizer should expand model_version -> model_version:exact. if shared_view true, we apply org-default filters override. I'm worried the override strip is accidentally dropping model_version when region present.

raj_backend: looking at normalizeFilters(), there's a short-circuit: if (isShared && hasRegion && hasOrgDefaults) { mergeAndSkip('model_version'); } — that looks wrong. pushing a hotfix branch to remove skip and instead merge arrays.

mira_qa: quick repro on staging before prod patch: staging dashboard 112 shows same empty bucket. i can attach logs: `query->filter=model_version:[]` meaning empty after normalization.

emily_support: thanks team. jacob, we're going to apply a targeted patch to normalization and roll to staging, then prod if green. ETA ~90m. will keep you updated in ticket #45289. :pray:

jacob_cust: appreciated. any mitigation for the meantime? the metrics are critical for our billing reconciliation today.

taylor_frontend: mitigation: you can open dashboard in incognito or as non-shared view (toggle off "Use org defaults") — that'll avoid org-default merge path.

raj_backend: patch merged to branch fix/normalize-shared-merge, running smoke tests now.

deploy-bot: canary deploy to prod-frontend started for fix/normalize-shared-merge :rocket:

mira_qa: can confirm canary shows model buckets restored for Region+Version at 1min post-deploy. regression test added.

emily_support: resolved for customer; closing loop in ticket. follow-up: add unit test for shared-view filter merging and a monitoring alert if filter normalization yields empty list unexpectedly.

jacob_cust: Verified on our side — charts back. thanks all! :tada:
